sources.excerpt: ZIM Dual Drive by Foxrox Electronics | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Foxrox Electronics ZIM Dual Drive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS Description ZIM's Channel B voicing section uses 8 cascading stages of phase shift which can be mixed both in and out of phase. This creates an almost limitless palate of tones simulating different amps and mic'ing techniques. ZIM's two channels use plug-in cards, called ZIMcards, for their processing. ZIM comes with a pair of ZIMcards already installed. The current default ZIMcards are Vintage Tube in Channel A and Hot 9 in Channel B. This pair gives a wide range of overdrive sounds. If you'd like us to customize your ZIM pedal with specific ZIMcards, choose Channel A and B cards from the dropdown menu above. Did you ever wish you had a Fuzz with a level boost? Or an Octave with overdrive? Or an overdrive with a switchable treble boost? Distortion and OD in one pedal? With ZIM you can pair up different effects to create your desert island pedal. If your tastes change and you need, for example, Fuzz instead of Distortion, you don't have to change pedals. Swap out the ZIMcard and now your ZIM is a Fuzz pedal. sources.excerpt: Classics Explore classic Foxrox Electronics pedals from the past, which are no longer in production. These include Captain Coconut, Captain Coconut2, Paradox TZF, Festival, ZIM and others that were retired to make way for new pedals. Skip to Main Content Home History Videos Dealers Classics Contact Hello, Guest | My Account (0) Items 0 Items Toggle navigation Pedals Accessories Specials Home Classics Classics Explore classic Foxrox pedals from the past. Click the images below to view the product's original features. You can also download the owner's manual on each page. ProVibe Last Manufactured in 1994 The first pedal made after registering the Foxrox Electronics name. Accurately produced the sounds of the classic Uni-Vibe effect. Its watery phasing and warm vibrato made it instantly recognizable, and Foxrox made them available in floor and rack-mount units. Captain Coconut Last Manufactured in July, 2001 Octave, Vibe and Fuzz effects in one unit. Captain Coconut brought together three of the most sought-after effects in one easy to use, reliable and great sounding box. All faithful reproductions of vintage effect circuitry, fine-tuned for the best sounds and added flexibility. Captain Coconut2 Last Manufactured in October, 2006 A re-design of the original Captain Coconut effect. CC2 set a new standard in limited production, hand-built guitar effects. The product features included a plug-in fuzz card, envelope controlled speed for the ProVibe, and improved speed control. Paradox TZ F Last Manufactured in October, 2006 An original design...not a clone. Paradox TZF is the first and only flanger of its kind. Through-zero-flanging was done in the '60s using a pair of analog tape decks. TZF recreates that over-the-top flanging sound in a stomp box. Octron Last Manufactured in December, 2016 Octron is an analog octave pedal. It's an organic effect that responds to your playing style/technique, and it takes on a new life when put through other effects. Octave up, down, clean with a little of each mixed...dial in just a hint of octave or make Octron your octave monster! CC Hybrid Fuzz Last Manufactured in September, 2017 CC Hybrid is one of the first pedals to use one germanium and one silicon transistor in the classic Fuzz Face circuit. Hot Silicon Fuzz Last Manufactured in June, 2019 Hot Silicon Fuzz is our take on the original high gain silicon FuzzFace, providing an array of fuzz tones to please even the pickiest players. Festival Overdrive Last Manufactured in December, 2020 The Festival Overdrive is a dual-mode overdrive. It features a master volume control and a boost channel with both gain and volume controls. Octron2 Last Manufactured in May, 2021 Octron2 is a special version of the Foxrox Octron pedal with the addition of individual foot switches with LED for Octave up, Direct, and Octave down. Inspired by feedback from Mahogany Rush guitarist, Frank Marino, improvements were made to the original Octron to arrive at something cool, new and unique. ZIM Dual Drive Last Manufactured in July, 2022 ZIM is a two-channel pedal that you can configure with any combination of Drive, Distortion, Fuzz, Boost and Octave using plug-in ZIMcards. Original Paradox TZF2 Last Manufactured in June, 2018 Paradox TZF2 is an analog Through-Zero Flanger geared towards live performance. Hot Silicon2 Fuzz Last Manufactured in May, 2024 Hot Silicon2 takes us back to 1986 when a young Dave Fox, while working for Dallas Music Industries, Inc, brought the Dallas Arbiter Fuzz Face back from extinction. 2Boost Two-Level Tunable Boost Last Manufactured in May, 2024 2Boost gives you two levels of adjustable clean boost, plus a phase shift filter that works as a powerful tone modifier. Octron4  Last Manufactured in August, 2025 Analog Octave Up, Down, and Direct, each with its own foot switch. Octave Down includes sub-octave sounds.
